gold_id_rail.blocks: the SEAL half of every suffixed Audio2Tool population (@ts2, @16k and @16k+ts2 alike). One rail unblocks all three.
gold_id_rail.precedent: reproduction.esb_reference.published_segment_key -- splits a derived-media id on the FIRST '@' and is provably inert for unsuffixed ids

what_preflight_proves: config composition, roster hydration with a per-file SHA-256 re-hash of all 400 media, media-path confinement to the variant's OWN derived root, the count check and ExecutionPlan construction all pass -- and only THEN does the real gate refuse, because these cells are not authorized. Reaching the gate is the CORRECT state.
where_the_rail_bites: rails/task_adapter.py:198 (score -> gold) called from core/flight/runtime.py:2653 (_row_for), i.e. per row immediately AFTER the response comes back from the fake transport. So the request half is proved and the seal half is unreachable until the rail lands -- not because sealing is broken, but because nothing downstream of the first row's metrics runs.
